points.point: The AI market requirement is stated as servers/data centers for AI and HPC deployment needing high-speed internal interconnect and interfaces (downstream tier of the high-speed SerDes eco-chain).
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions AI data-center connectivity/high-speed transmission, but not the specific AI/HPC server/data-center requirement from the SerDes eco-chain

points.point: The measurable signal-integrity parameters for high-speed PCB/PCBA are IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram and TDR impedance (Slide 20 signal integrity flow).
points.label: covered
points.why: lists IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR impedance

points.point: The Interface Test block maps to the oscilloscope (Scopes) together with BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices — this is the required oscilloscope capability for high-speed interface validation.
points.label: partial
points.why: states scopes for Interface Test/high-speed interface validation, but omits BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices

points.point: The Power Distribution Network block maps to oscilloscopes plus network analyzers, giving a second oscilloscope capability leg (PDN / power integrity).
points.label: covered
points.why: states PDN testing maps to scopes and network analyzers

points.point: On the power side, the AI requirement (Blackwell platform power doubling, high-density power demand) is mapped to MXO for power rail / multiphase DC / PI measurement.
points.label: partial
points.why: maps power rail/multiphase DC/PI to MXO, but does not state Blackwell power doubling/high-density power demand

points.point: For AI server motherboard/PCBA, the measurable parameters PDN Target Z and power rail / multiphase DC / PI are mapped to R&S ZNL and MXO respectively.
points.label: covered
points.why: states PDN Target Z maps to R&S ZNL and power rail/multiphase DC/PI maps to MXO

points.point: The Vault explicitly records that the source provides no oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate or test standard, so the chain cannot be quantified into a scope specification.
points.label: covered
points.why: says no scope bandwidth, sample rate, model, data-rate configuration, or compliance details are specified

points.point: The instrument mappings carry no option, firmware, fixture or calibration conditions, limiting them to sales-level clues rather than a formal test configuration.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions missing option, fixture, and calibration details, but not firmware or sales-level-only limitation
